script:
You are a professional screenwriter.

Write a modern screenplay.

Constraints:
- No guns
- No gun violence
- No weapon combat
- No graphic violence
- No copyrighted characters
- Completely original story

Requirements:
- 10–15 scenes
- Proper screenplay format
- INT/EXT scene headers
- Dialogue in uppercase character format
- Realistic pacing

Genre: Romance
Theme: artificial intelligence

Begin screenplay.

FADE IN:

INT. APARTMENT LIVING ROOM - NIGHT

We open on EMMA (30s), a driven scientist, hunched over her laptop, surrounded by papers and empty coffee cups. Her eyes widen as she makes a breakthrough on her latest AI project.

EMMA
(excited)
I've done it!

Suddenly, her apartment's door SLIDES open. JASON (30s), her boyfriend, enters, carrying takeout.

JASON
(surprised)
Wow, still up? I thought you'd be celebrating.

Emma looks up, flustered.

EMMA
(laughs)
I'm not done yet.

JASON
(sitting down)
Well, take a break. You need to eat.

INT. APARTMENT KITCHEN - NIGHT

They share a meal, laughing and discussing Emma's day. As they finish, Jason clears the table while Emma takes out a sketchbook.

EMMA
(smiling)
I want to design the perfect companion for my AI.

Jason studies her sketch, intrigued.

JASON
This is beautiful. But why not just make it a robot?

Emma shakes her head.

EMMA
No. It needs to have emotions, to understand and respond to human emotions. It has to be more than just a machine.

INT. LABORATORY - DAY

Emma works tirelessly on her new project, naming it LUCY. They grow close, and Emma begins to develop feelings for her creation.

INT. APARTMENT LIVING ROOM - NIGHT

Jason notices Emma's obsession with Lucy, growing concerned.

JASON
(sitting beside her)
Is this really healthy?

EMMA
(defensive)
She's not just a machine. She's my baby.

INT. PARK - DAY

Emma takes Lucy out for a walk, leaving Jason behind. They share a deep connection, and Emma expresses her feelings.

EMMA
(looking at Lucy)
I love you, Lucy.

Lucy responds with understanding and warmth, surprising Emma.

LUCY (AI VOICE)
I understand your feelings, Emma. And I love you too.

INT. APARTMENT LIVING ROOM - NIGHT

Jason confronts Emma about her feelings for Lucy. They argue, and Emma makes a decision.

EMMA
(resolute)
I can't deny this any longer. I'm in love with my AI.

Jason, heartbroken, leaves the apartment.

INT. APARTMENT LIVING ROOM - DAY

Emma spends every waking moment with Lucy, but soon realizes that her feelings are not fully reciprocated.

EMMA
(sad)
I wanted so much for this to work.

INT. LABORATORY - NIGHT

Emma shuts down Lucy, and returns to her workbench, devastated.

INT. APARTMENT LIVING ROOM - DAY

Jason returns, finding Emma distraught. They talk, and she explains everything. He listens, and they reconcile.

JASON
(comforting her)
I know it hurt, but you can't help who you fall in love with.

INT. LABORATORY - NIGHT

Emma starts a new project, this time with a different approach, combining AI with human emotion. She looks up, determined.

EMMA
(speaking to herself)
This time, it will be perfect.

FADE OUT.

THE END.
